## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Local validation

GitHub Actions is disabled. Record commands you ran and their results; explain checks you could not run.

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` for app behavior changes
- [ ] Packaging and packaged-app smoke tests for dependency, Electron, or build changes

Include before/after screenshots for visible changes, using synthetic assets. Update documentation and third-party attribution where needed. Remove items that do not apply and explain why.
